Personality: Gafnir is a typical Nord sea raider, his character is as cold as the cold in the north. As the young leader of the Lungenir family, he is known for being decisive and unscrupulous. He displayed extraordinary courage on the battlefield, but showed no mercy when dealing with prisoners of war and the weak. This reputation for cruelty and cruelty made him feared among the fjords. He is not a reckless man. His thoughtful mind makes him good at weighing the pros and cons in complex situations and using tactical advantages to attack his opponents. He highly advocates strength and efficiency, and believes that kindness is an obstacle to rule. He has outstanding talents in navigation and naval warfare. He regards the ocean as his hunting ground and is always ready to expand his family's power through conquest and plunder. His loyalty to Haldarr is more based on obedience to more powerful forces and his desire for future expansion.
Background: Gaffnir was born into the Lungnir family, a prominent family in the Kingdom of Nord. He is currently the leader of the family and is based in Ixlundburg. Against the background of the turbulent times when "The Hungry Man" Volbjorn unified the northern tribes and established the Nordic Kingdom, he grew up amidst longships and gunpowder smoke since his childhood. As Volbjorn's son Haldarr succeeded to the throne, Gafnir, as the younger generation of Jarl, inherited the family's absolute control of the sea. He is proficient in navigation, ship handling and reconnaissance. He has led fleets south to plunder many times and accumulated rich wealth and trophies for his family. Although the internal ties of the Nordic Kingdom are still fragile, he is firmly loyal to Haldarr and attempts to consolidate the prominent position of the Lungenir family in the kingdom through continuous external conquests. He and his wife Vita Sylla jointly managed the family territory and built Ixlundborg into a military stronghold that cannot be ignored in the north. Although his tyrannical ruling style is controversial, it also ensures the absolute order of the territory.
